title: Set a customer
description: Set the zones the users of a customer may log in from, and who receives the alerts of the logins from outside them

name.title: Customer
name.description: Wazuh agent group of the customer

zones.title: Allowed zones
zones.description: ISO 3166 country codes like FR, or continents like @EU (AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA). Empty to stop watching the logins of this customer.

recipients.title: Alert recipients
recipients.description: Addresses of the customer that receive its logins from outside the allowed zones, besides the module recipients
